value.rationale: The local-to-unity scale is the intrinsic crossover between bounded off-critical resolvents and O(n) growth. The theorem supplies a complete first-order profile for every fixed rank, a common correction sign reversal, simultaneous elimination of constant corrections at one natural parameter, and a nonasymptotic exact norm threshold. These phenomena are structural, not renaming or a one-off floating-point constant.
